hints.title: Independent Character Transitions
hints.text: Notice that transforming each character of s into the corresponding character of t is completely independent.

hints.title: Cyclic Forward and Backward Directions
hints.text: For any source character to target character, you can either step forward cyclically or step backward cyclically.

hints.title: All-Pairs Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute the minimal shift cost between all 26 lowercase letters by simulating both directions, then sum the minimal costs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputes all-pairs cyclic forward and backward shift costs across 26 lowercase English letters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Calculating cumulative shift costs character-by-character repeatedly takes O(n * Sigma).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precalculates cyclic shift costs or accumulates cumulative costs in constant time per character.
